title: Agreement Is Not Skill
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Three panels walk through the Chapter 14 example: 18 of 20 agree, most of that agreement is expected by chance, and kappa is only 0.44.

educational.topic: Why a high agreement rate can hide a low kappa
learningObjectives: The learner will compute Cohen's kappa from a count table and explain why 90 percent agreement can be a kappa of only 0.44.
prerequisites: Inter-rater agreement and Cohen's kappa from [Chapter 14](../../chapters/14-checking-agent-output/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: How much agreement would chance alone give?
Which resources did the agent miss?
commonMisconceptions: Kappa and percent agreement are the same number
assessmentOpportunities: Why is a 90 percent agreement not impressive in this example?
What is the formula for kappa?
What should you always show beside kappa?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
